articles.author: Zenta Group Co Ltd
articles.headline: Zenta Group Subsidiary ZentoAI Signs Binding MOU For Strategic Acquisition
articles.summary: Zenta reports that ZentoAI signed an MOU for a controlling stake in a mainland China digital technology provider. Despite binding confidentiality and governing-law terms, the MOU does not oblige either party to complete the acquisition; definitive agreements, due diligence and approvals remain outstanding.
